verdict.rationale: stagewise's own docs index describes it as "the open-source agentic IDE" (stagewise-probe-1). The README content is published in a public GitHub repo, stagewise-io/stagewise (stagewise-gh-1, stagewise-gh-2), so the source is readable and positioned as open. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g. MIT/Apache/AGPL), there is no evidence about whether the desktop IDE's full source (vs. parts) is in the repo, and there is no independent corroboration of the license terms.
